name: Elevated Basics - Relaxed - White Color
description:
Fit: Relaxed
Fabric: 100% cotton, 240 GSM French Terry
 Model Size: Male - M, Female - S
Color: White
How To Style:
The White Elevated Basics Relaxed T-shirt offers a clean, relaxed aesthetic. Pair it with dark skinny jeans or cargo pants for a balanced look. Layer it under a denim jacket for a casual street-style vibe, or keep it simple with sneakers and a cap for an easy, laid-back outfit.
Wash Care: 

Machine Wash at 86° F / 30°  C
No Chlorine Bleach
Do not tumble dry
Maximum iron at 230° F / 110 ° C
Dry Clean
Wash inside out and dry separately
